transcript: If you've been feeling off, listen. These are the top five signs your body is overly toxic and needs a gentle detox, according to Chinese medicine. 1. Low energy all day. When the liver and spleen are overloaded, your energy becomes heavy and you feel tired for no clear reason. 2. Brain fog. Toxic build-up creates dampness that rises to the head, making you feel cloudy or unfocused. 3. Bloating and slow digestion. If your body can't process food properly, it's a strong sign the system needs cleansing support. 4. Skin problems. Breakouts, dull skin, or irritation often mean your body is trying to push out what it can't filter. 5. Irritability and emotional tension. When the liver is overloaded, emotions stagnate. You feel on edge, tense, or easily overwhelmed. My friend, these signs are not here to frighten you. They're your body asking for balance again. Comment, detox, and I will tag you in my next video on how to detox properly. And if you want deeper guidance, my full Chinese medicine e-book is in the link on my profile.
